Topics covered in this PDF

BPCE-141 (Positive Psychology) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Mindfulness, positive parenting, stress, Patanjali's yoga, Snyder's model of hope
  • PERMA model, social and positive psychology, gratitude, emotional storytelling, psychological capital

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: tutor marked assignment, all questions compulsory, total marks 100
  • Assignment One: questions 1 and 2, about 500 words each, 2 x 20 = 40 marks
  • Assignment Two: questions 3 to 5, about 250 words each, 3 x 10 = 30 marks
  • Assignment Three: questions 6 to 10, about 100 words each, 5 x 6 = 30 marks

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
